transform_evidence.reference_pose_semantics: GetRefPoseTransform returns each bone transform relative to its parent. SetRenderStatic renders the mesh in reference pose.
transform_evidence.multiplication_semantics: A * B applies A first, then B. Accumulate R = identity, then R = R * local_bone while walking head to root, including the root transform.
transform_evidence.attachment_derivation: R maps head-bone coordinates to reference mesh/component coordinates. Relative = R.Inverse() maps the reference mesh back to head-bone coordinates. Attaching that component to the animated Body head bone yields reference vertices * R.Inverse() * BodyHeadToWorld.
transform_evidence.required_checks: Use Flex head bone index/parent chain, not Hero reference transforms. Require valid head bone on both meshes and a root-reaching, bounded parent walk. Clear LeaderPose before static reference rendering. Do not replace the offset with an approximate height.
transform_evidence.limitations: Rigid head/neck/hair; no facial animation. Neck seam fit remains untested. This removes transferred bone deformation, not arbitrary material vertex effects.
